questions.question: Sort a circle, a triangle and a semicircle by the kind of sides they have. Explain each one.
questions.expected_answer: The triangle has only straight sides, 3 of them. The circle has only a curved side. The semicircle has both a straight side and a curved side, so it goes in the group for both.

questions.question: A tiny triangle and a huge triangle are sorted by number of sides. Do they go in the same group? Explain.
questions.expected_answer: Yes. Both have 3 sides. Size does not change the number of sides, so they both belong in the 3-sided group.

questions.question: Describe how to draw a rectangle 5 squares long and 3 squares high on grid paper.
questions.expected_answer: Start at a corner where lines cross. Go 5 squares right, 3 squares up, 5 squares left and 3 squares down to the start. Count squares, not lines, and check that the opposite sides are equal.
